features.heading: What you can do here
features.offers: Receive appointment offers by SMS or email
features.messages: Send and read messages with the clinic
features.records: See your records after your first visit

how.heading: How it works
how.step1Body: Sign up with your mobile number. We send a one-time code to confirm it.
how.step2Body: Choose a time that suits you, or accept a time the clinic offers.
how.step3Body: Get messages and reminders about your visit in the portal.

faq.heading: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: How do I create an account?
faq.a1: Choose Sign up and enter your mobile number. We will send a one-time code to confirm it.
faq.q2: Can I use the portal in Tamil?
faq.a2: Yes. Use the language menu at the top of any page to switch between English and Tamil.
